purpose: Define the reusable intake shape for Tiled-compatible terrain tilesets whose tiles declare four terrain-corner labels.

sourceRequirements.tsx: A Tiled .tsx tileset with tilewidth, tileheight, image, terraintypes, and tile terrain attributes. The columns may be derived from the image width when the TSX omits a columns attribute.
sourceRequirements.png: The image referenced by the TSX, using the same tile grid as the TSX.
sourceRequirements.tileTerrainAttribute: Each usable tile declares terrain="topLeft,topRight,bottomLeft,bottomRight" using terraintype indexes. Blank corner indexes are preserved as the manifest emptyTerrainName.

generatedManifest.terrainTypes: ordered list of all Tiled terrain names
generatedManifest.tileKindTerrainMap: optional Havenwild TileKind/editor material aliases to Tiled terrain names
generatedManifest.editorMaterials: one native Havenwild generic terrain material record for every Tiled terrain name

runtimeRules: One terrain boundary renderer owns a cell at a time.
A complete Tiled corner tuple replaces the full 32x32 cell; it is not composited over another transition renderer.
Pure fills may be cataloged before they become paintable.
All source terrain names are ingested as native editor catalog materials.
Paintability is controlled by Havenwild runtime storage support and semantic material mappings, not by raw source terrain names.
Unsupported terrain names remain cataloged and visible in planning reports until promoted.
promotionChecklist: Confirm credits/license are included beside the source TSX/PNG.
Verify every terrain type has at least one pure fill tuple or mark it derived-only.
Map desired terrain names to Havenwild TileKind/editor material IDs.
Add renderer ownership tests so no legacy terrain system draws on mapped boundary cells.
Generate a numbered preview or report for user confirmation before exposing new brushes.
